newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa women's investment body opens share offer.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa women's investment body opens share offer.

text.p: South Africa's Women Investment Portfolio Holdings' invitation to women only to subscribe for shares in the company opened on Wednesday until August 6, the company said in an announcement.
It said its key objective was the "empowerment of women" through investments in a portfolio of listed companies.
Business Day newspaper reported the group was seeking to raise 40 million rand through the issue of 20-million B shares at two rand each.
Management intended to use the subscription to discharge the short-term liability and for working capital requirements and investments.
